subject: Re: Menger-RL kickoff — capacity plan
body:
Ulla,

Capacity plan for the milestones:

Staffing — Leilani 60% (TL), Milan 50% on the actor-fleet orchestration, Vera 50% on the learner/training-stack bridge, Efe 25% advising on the RL side.

CPU — the 1,000-worker actor fleet is approved on the shared batch pool; we scale to 3,000 workers for the June soak, matching the scale the framework was designed for.

Accelerators — the learner soak is the big ask. We hold the vulcan-h100 reservation with 512 accelerators for the week of 2026-06-22. Note vulcan's maintenance window runs 06-22 to 06-24, so our reservation effectively starts Wednesday 06-24 midday; I've planned the soak as a 4-day burn Wed-Sat, which still lands results before the 06-26 OKR review (interim numbers Thursday night, Ulla — that's your slide).

Tight but doable. Milan's orchestration needs to be soak-ready by 06-17.

Bao
